title: The mass measure vanishes where the orientation vanishes (parent step 8)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U, W, C ⊆ ℝ^P with W and C measurable and C ⊆ W, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), μ a measure on ℝ^P with μ(W) < ∞ and T.massOn W = μ(W), and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n (MultiVector P n) with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for all x and α and T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). If ξ(x) = 0 for μ-a.e. x ∈ C, then μ(C) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W C : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet W → MeasurableSet C → C ⊆ W → μ W < ∞ → T.massOn W = μ W → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ C → ξ x = 0) → μ C = 0
